blocks.en: τ_w is about 1.4–4.2 Pa in operation (γ 2,000–6,000 s⁻¹). Measured on this rig: B. subtilis still grew to OD600 3.5 at 6,000 s⁻¹ and kept secreting protein for 60+ hours. The γ upper limit of 11,000 s⁻¹ is the laminar-model limit (Re < 2000), not a cell-tolerance limit — above it, γ_flow = 8v/d and τ_w themselves stop being valid.
blocks.zh: 運轉時 τ_w 約為 1.4–4.2 Pa（γ 2,000–6,000 s⁻¹）。本機實測：枯草桿菌（B. subtilis）在 6,000 s⁻¹ 下仍長到 OD600 3.5，並持續分泌蛋白質超過 60 小時。γ 的上限 11,000 s⁻¹ 是層流模型的極限（Re < 2000），不是細胞耐受的極限；超過它之後，γ_flow = 8v/d 與 τ_w 本身就不再成立。

attrs.en: (TMP_in + TMP_out)/2 = (P_in + P_out)/2 − P_s − ρgh/2 (half the shell water column subtracted since v5.0); experimental variable during TMP scans.
attrs.zh: (TMP_in + TMP_out)/2 = (P_in + P_out)/2 − P_s − ρgh/2（v5.0 起扣除殼側水柱的一半）；TMP 掃描時的實驗自變數。

attrs.en: 1 L vessel losing 0.7 mL/min: a ±10% feed error drifts ±100 mL per day; long runs need level/weight feedback to the feed pump. Sensor not installed.
attrs.zh: 1 L 槽體以 0.7 mL/min 流失：補料若有 ±10% 誤差，一天就漂 ±100 mL；長期運轉需要液位／槽重回饋到補料幫浦。感測器尚未安裝。

attrs.en: D = Q_perm × 0.06 / V (h⁻¹, 1 L vessel); confirms the dilution rate matches the setpoint (design ~0.04 h⁻¹).
attrs.zh: D = Q_perm × 0.06 / V（h⁻¹，1 L 槽體）；確認稀釋率與設定值相符（設計值約 0.04 h⁻¹）。

attrs.en: Friction pressure drop after subtracting the gravity offset.
attrs.zh: 扣除重力偏移後的摩擦壓降。

attrs.en: J = Q_perm / A (LMH). Design point ~2 LMH (Q_perm ≈ 0.7 mL/min), set by nutrient consumption, not by membrane capacity.
attrs.zh: J = Q_perm / A（LMH）。設計運轉點約 2 LMH（Q_perm ≈ 0.7 mL/min），由養分消耗決定，不是由薄膜能力決定。

attrs.en: L_p = J / TMP_mean (LMH/bar), the primary fouling indicator. At this low flux fouling should be very slow, so any decline signals an abnormality (e.g. cells breaking through to the shell). Alerts below 70% of the initial value.
attrs.zh: L_p = J / TMP_mean（LMH/bar），積垢的主要指標。在這麼低的通量下積垢應該極慢，因此任何下降都代表異常（例如菌穿透到殼側）。跌破初始值的 70% 即發出警報。

attrs.en: P_in − (P_s + ρgh); for precise axial profiles.
attrs.zh: P_in − (P_s + ρgh)；用於精確的軸向分佈。

attrs.en: Rate of change of TMP_mean (kPa/min, in-phase regression). Reference only; no longer raises alerts.
attrs.zh: TMP_mean 隨時間的變化率（kPa/min，階段內迴歸）。僅供參考，不再觸發警報。

attrs.en: Shell-side pressure; should stay near atmospheric. An unexplained rise = drainage blocked.
attrs.zh: 殼側壓力，應貼近大氣壓；無故上升 = 排液受阻。

attrs.en: TMP_mean / (μ·J); compare before/after cleaning.
attrs.zh: TMP_mean / (μ·J)；比較清洗前後。

attrs.en: TMP_out = P_out − P_s (same height, no gravity correction). Must stay positive: forward filtration throughout, no Starling backflow. Small text is the strict version: min P_out trough over the last 3 s − P_s.
attrs.zh: TMP_out = P_out − P_s（兩者等高，不做重力修正）。必須恆為正：全程正向過濾，無 Starling 倒流。小字是嚴格版：最近 3 s 的 P_out 波谷最低值 − P_s。

attrs.en: V_shell / Q_perm; plan sampling time resolution.
attrs.zh: V_shell / Q_perm；用於規劃取樣的時間解析度。

attrs.en: Wall shear stress, reference only (1.4–4.2 Pa); far below cell-damage thresholds.
attrs.zh: 壁面剪應力，僅供參考（1.4–4.2 Pa）；遠低於細胞損傷門檻。

attrs.en: ΔP_friction / TMP_mean; judges whether the mean is representative during TMP scans.
attrs.zh: ΔP_friction / TMP_mean；判斷 TMP 掃描時這個平均值是否具代表性。

attrs.en: ΔP_friction = (P_in − P_out) − ρgh: true friction drop after removing the 60 cm water column; the only signal that detects biomass build-up in the lumen without opening the module. Shown as measured / baseline at the same flow; > 1.3 alerts.
attrs.zh: ΔP_friction = (P_in − P_out) − ρgh：扣除 60 cm 水柱後的真實摩擦壓降，是唯一不拆開模組就能偵測管腔內菌體堆積的訊號。以實測／同流量下的基準顯示；> 1.3 發出警報。

attrs.en: γ (pressure) / γ (flow, Q_L × 15.4). The divergence directly reflects a drop in effective fibre count — the best single clogging indicator. Normal ≈ 1.0; > 1.3 alerts.
attrs.zh: γ（壓力）／γ（流量，Q_L × 15.4）。兩者的分歧直接反映有效纖維數下降，是最好的單一阻塞指標。正常 ≈ 1.0；> 1.3 發出警報。

attrs.en: γ = τ_w / μ, τ_w = ΔP_friction·d/(4L). The pressure version does not contain n_eff, so it reflects the real shear increase when fibres clog. 2,000 s⁻¹ recommended, 6,000 s⁻¹ upper limit.
attrs.zh: γ = τ_w / μ，τ_w = ΔP_friction·d/(4L)。壓力版不含 n_eff，因此纖維阻塞時能反映實際上升的剪切率。建議 2,000 s⁻¹，上限 6,000 s⁻¹。

attrs.en: ρ·v·d/μ; confirms laminar flow (operating range 360–1070).
attrs.zh: ρ·v·d/μ；確認為層流（運轉範圍 360–1070）。
